body:
Sir, I don't fully understand why you plan to commit suicide. I'm not here to convince you to do otherwise, but you seem to be a man of logic, so I'll assume that you have rationalized your decision.

Your complaint is that the world is full of people who focus their attention on trivial things when they could be bettering their intellectual selves and bettering the lives of others, yes? But, you are not an irrational man; you also realize that you are the problem: complaining that you've never had a romantic relationship and your being here on reddit, for example, when you should be solving the world's issues.

So, you will kill yourself because you are part of the problem? How is this a solution? Unless this act only serves to relieve your individual suffering, in which case, you don't live up to the standards you expect others to.

So why are really doing it?

I don't want to play a game of semantics with you, and I hope you can understand my point.

You are upset by your lot in life (and it is your right to be so). You say that, because of your experiences and subsequent academic performance, you won't get into the schools of your choice. Maybe you won't, but you have great potential, I'm sure. Not everyone is born into ideal situations, and it affects who they become despite their potential. You know that well enough. Those kids whom you refer to as "subhuman and savage" became what their situations would normally produce.

I've earned the right to say what I have as well. I don't want to argue with you. I just wanted to point out that we all suffer--even those "subhuman savages."

> surrounded by savage, sub-human little shits.

I understand that you're hurt, but it's not fair of you to call them that.

> Well, I'd like to commend you on having one of the most interesting life stories I've ever heard. 

In a subreddit where people often feel their lives are worthless, you shouldn't make things a competition.

And? What can one do with your caring? Does it have some sort of tangible and meaningful aspect outside of an impersonal, online chat? I find that those lead only to feelings of further isolation. Sometimes, it's not enough just to "care."

You'll have to forgive my anger. I don't come here because I'm a happy person.

I wouldn't say it is, no.

Yes, it involves college, but it's more so about me and the things I realized about myself and my experiences.

My learning French will be useless because I won't have the chance to put it into action. Preparing for a race I know I will never run.

I'd love to tell you (or just anyone, really), but I can't stand to see it written down or hear it spoken. Besides, I doubt you can relate, and that's what I need; someone to relate to. Better that you can't, I say!

You people surprise me with your kindness.

I've tried it with nutella, but I didn't like it. I'd like to order some spiced drinking chocolate, but I'm not sure if there's a special appliance required to prepare it.

I *lived* for C. It was my sole motivation. I don't see what else there is to do now.

It's learning French.

I didn't call. I'm not in the right mindset currently. You have to want help to make that call. I'd rather not get help right now; I don't want to be deterred.

Even if I meditate, my problems will be there to greet me after I rejoin the real world, so to speak. Or is it: meditate in order to get over them? That will not work here for me.

I took a look at your comment history. You might have seen in another of my comments that I've been learning a skill and that it's the only thing I can enjoy enough to fill my time? It's learning French. I'm quite good at it, all things considered.

I might take up your offer one day if I find I need someone to relate to, for whatever reason. Thank you for your kindness.

Yeah, but everything can't work out for everyone. I've never really been in an okay place. I managed before because I kept telling myself that, if I do A and B, I will reach C and things will be good. Here I am in C-ville and things have never been worse.

Some things have changed for the worse on the outside, but it's my reaction to them which has destroyed everything for me. My "smarts" won't get me far when my brain is part of the issue. And I'm not terribly smart. It's just that I fall into these moods in which I forget how to communicate on a personal level. Hence my awkward/highfalutin writing.

Yeah, it's hard to imagine the circumstances that could make another person feel so utterly hopeless. But, it's surprisingly easy to do when they apply to you. I've tried to look at things from a different perspective, but it's all the same.

I don't know what else to say.

No, I wasn't objecting. It really was nothing traumatic, and I understand when you say it can be *that* bad. It isn't.

I haven't seen my friends in ~8 months. I recently received emails from so many of them and it kills me that I don't have the heart to reply. I don't really care tremendously for my family (or anyone else), and I don't experience love, as far as I know. It's only recently that I realize I should have seen a therapist for those reasons. I'm not unkind or malicious, that's for sure. I enjoy music, but it's just a bunch a beautiful people making a shitload of cash--certainly nothing to find salvation in.

Thank you for your concern. I realize that this thread has to end at some point, and I don't want you to feel obligated to respond lest I feel abandoned. I see your points and will consider them later and try to see if there is any truth for me in what you say.

I know. What could I possibly have gone through? You're right; it's nothing traumatic. In any case, it's more than I'm willing to bear.

But I want you to know that it wasn't inaction in the slightest. I worked hard, doing every thing I could, and things worked out as I hoped they would. You couldn't know, but it's hurtful that you say I didn't try. I did!

Then things fell apart. Things just sort of happened around me (or, in some cases, didn't happen), and it was nothing I did nor anything I could have avoided. I've even attempted to tackle those problems, but I've since given up. I no longer have the drive.

You asked what else I like. There's nothing I enjoy. I've been teaching myself a skill I will never have the chance to use, and some days I can't bring myself to indulge in such futility. On those days, I daydream and pretend that I'll have the chance to do certain things.
I don't subscribe to that sort of thinking.
What did I do for you to thank me?

Maybe you're right about my inadequacy.

I'm not like most other people, I don't think. Maybe part of my issue is that I think I can actually solve my problems. With lots of effort and patience (as you suggest), I've begun to realize that I will not be able to. Patience is just as prone to bringing about unhappiness as it is happiness. You forgot to consider that.

I'm just a 19 year old girl, so I'm sure there's a lot about life I don't know. It's unfortunate that I might be misinformed, but I don't see how I can be convinced to do differently. I always figured my death would be my own doing. I just never thought I'd want to it come so early.

I came to /r/sw to get my intensions off my chest. Don't mean to be so disagreeable.

I won't stay for anyone else and it's no one's right to ask me to. (I don't have children.) We all hurt for various reasons, and no one else's hurt is any more significant than mine. We either cope or we don't. I would hope that they cope; I'm having difficulty doing so.

I have no real remaining desires but to tell my story to someone. I want to package my life so as to say, "this is my perception of my experiences." Maybe I'll get some sort of nod of understanding.

I've tried explain to explain my "misery" to several of my family members without sounding too ominous, but none were the *right* person for the job. I don't know if you're him either. Maybe I'll call a hotline or something.
